assignments.package_label: נִשְׁמָע, תְּפִלָּה וּמַאֲמַר הַשָּׁלֵם — קֹדֶם הַבְּרִיאָה
assignments.reason: חדוות ה' (the joy of God) is the experiential quality of the transcendent nishma-domain. The teaching says 'כי חדוות ה' היא מעוזכם' — this joy is achieved through נעשה ונשמע and is perfected through יראה/תפלה. Its essential nature is the divine delight that belongs to the hidden, aspirational dimension of service — the same domain as שמחה (already in Package 1) but in its specifically divine/transcendent form.

assignments.package_label: נִשְׁמָע, תְּפִלָּה וּמַאֲמַר הַשָּׁלֵם — קֹדֶם הַבְּרִיאָה
assignments.reason: שמחה וחדוה (joy and delight) is a compound expressing the same essential reality as שמחה (already in Package 1). The teaching equates it with חדוות ה' and with the experience of נעשה ונשמע. Its nature is the inner experiential state of the transcendent/prayer domain — joy perfected through יראה.

assignments.package_label: נִשְׁמָע, תְּפִלָּה וּמַאֲמַר הַשָּׁלֵם — קֹדֶם הַבְּרִיאָה
assignments.reason: שלמות השמחה (the completion/perfection of joy) belongs to Package 1 because the teaching explicitly states 'עיקר שלמות השמחה הוא על ידי יראה, שהיא בחינת נשמע, בחינת תפלה'. The perfection of joy is achieved through the very essence of Package 1: יראה = נשמע = תפלה = מאמר השלם. Its essential nature IS the completeness-dimension that defines this package.

assignments.node_id: תפלה, שהוא בחינות יראה, בחינות מאמר השלם
assignments.package_label: נִשְׁמָע, תְּפִלָּה וּמַאֲמַר הַשָּׁלֵם — קֹדֶם הַבְּרִיאָה
assignments.reason: This is a verbose compound node explicitly naming three concepts already in Package 1 (תפלה, יראה, מאמר השלם). Its essential nature is the prayer/awe/complete-utterance domain. It appears in an eitza edge showing that prayer builds faith, but its nature IS prayer — the core of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: תפלה, שהוא בחינות יראה כנ"ל, שהיא בחינות נשמע, בחינות מאמר השלם, ששם עקר השלמות כנ"ל.
assignments.package_label: נִשְׁמָע, תְּפִלָּה וּמַאֲמַר הַשָּׁלֵם — קֹדֶם הַבְּרִיאָה
assignments.reason: An even longer verbose compound node explicitly naming תפלה = יראה = נשמע = מאמר השלם — all core members of Package 1. This is the same reality described with maximum detail. It is essentially a self-referencing description of Package 1's entire domain.

assignments.node_id: נעשה ונשמע, שהוא בחינות תורה ותפלה וכו
assignments.package_label: נִשְׁמָע, תְּפִלָּה וּמַאֲמַר הַשָּׁלֵם — קֹדֶם הַבְּרִיאָה
assignments.reason: This is a verbose variant of נעשה ונשמע (already in Package 1), expanded to include 'תורה ותפלה'. While it bridges Packages 1 and 2 conceptually (נעשה = Torah = Package 2, נשמע = prayer = Package 1), the compound as a whole — as the source of שמחה — belongs in Package 1 where נעשה ונשמע is already assigned. The unifying experience of 'doing and hearing' is the joy-producing reality of this package.

assignments.package_label: עַזּוּת דִּקְדֻשָּׁה וְקוֹלוֹת — הַשּׁוֹפָר וְהַתְּרוּעָה
assignments.reason: לעזות דקדשה (to holy boldness) is the same concept as עזות דקדשה (already in Package 3), just in its directional/target grammatical form. Its essential nature IS holy boldness — the core of Package 3. It appears as the effect of שמחה, but its nature is boldness/voice, not joy.

assignments.node_id: לזה עזות דקדשה – הינו קולות הנ"ל
assignments.package_label: עַזּוּת דִּקְדֻשָּׁה וְקוֹלוֹת — הַשּׁוֹפָר וְהַתְּרוּעָה
assignments.reason: This compound node explicitly equates עזות דקדשה with קולות — both already core members of Package 3. The text says 'וצריך לזה עזות דקדושה — הינו קולות הנ"ל' — holy boldness IS the voices. Its essential nature is holy boldness expressed as voice, which is exactly Package 3's domain.

assignments.package_label: עַזּוּת דִּקְדֻשָּׁה וְקוֹלוֹת — הַשּׁוֹפָר וְהַתְּרוּעָה
assignments.reason: משבר עזות הגוף (breaking the body's boldness) describes the active function of holy boldness — it is what the שופר/קולות DO. While the target (עזות הגוף) belongs to Package 4 (evil), the act of breaking it IS the essential function of Package 3's holy boldness. 'אנחה שוברת גופו של אדם' — the breaking IS the voice's operation. Its nature is the action-dimension of holy boldness.

assignments.node_id: משברין עזות דסטרא אחרא, שהוא בחינת עזות הגוף
assignments.package_label: עַזּוּת דִּקְדֻשָּׁה וְקוֹלוֹת — הַשּׁוֹפָר וְהַתְּרוּעָה
assignments.reason: This compound describes the same active function as משבר עזות הגוף — the breaking of evil boldness by holy boldness. Although it names the evil target (עזות דסטרא אחרא = Package 4), the verb 'משברין' is the holy action performed by the voices/shofar of Package 3. The essential nature of this node is the victorious function of holy boldness against its evil mirror.

assignments.package_label: עַזּוּת דִּקְדֻשָּׁה וְקוֹלוֹת — הַשּׁוֹפָר וְהַתְּרוּעָה
assignments.reason: Another formulation of the breaking of bodily boldness ('when one breaks the boldness and strength of the body'). Same essential nature as the other 'breaking' nodes — the operative function of holy boldness (Package 3). It is the condition under which the soul can approach the body, but the breaking itself IS the work of the voices.

assignments.package_label: עַזּוּת דְּסִטְרָא אָחֳרָא — עַזּוּת הַגּוּף
assignments.reason: להנצל מהם, מתחת ממשלתם (being saved from them, from under their dominion) describes escape from the evil shepherds' rule. The 'them' refers to the רועים של הסטרא אחרא whose dominion is עזות = מלכותא בלא תגא. The essential nature of this node is the evil dominion itself — the condition of being under evil-azut's power. It belongs in Package 4 because it describes the state produced by evil boldness, not the act of holy boldness that liberates from it.

assignments.package_label: רַגְלִין, מוֹכִיחִים וְשִׁבְעָה רוֹעִים — הֶחָכָם וְהָעָם
assignments.reason: רועים (shepherds) is the generic term for the holy shepherds — the seven shepherds (שבעה רועים) who tend faith (רעה אמונה). The text says 'אמונה הוא מהרועים' — faith comes FROM the shepherds. Its essential nature is holy leadership — the shepherds/tzaddikim domain of Package 5. It is the cause of faith (Package 6) but its nature IS shepherding.

assignments.package_label: רַגְלִין, מוֹכִיחִים וְשִׁבְעָה רוֹעִים — הֶחָכָם וְהָעָם
assignments.reason: רועים דקדשה (holy shepherds) is the explicit qualified form of the shepherds concept. The text says 'הם הרועים דקדושה, שאי אפשר להתקרב להם כי אם על ידי עזות דקדושה'. Its essential nature IS holy shepherding/leadership — the core of Package 5. They are the ones who fill faith (Package 6), but they themselves ARE the leadership domain.

assignments.node_id: לבוא לאלו הרועים, שהם כלליות של הקדשה
assignments.package_label: רַגְלִין, מוֹכִיחִים וְשִׁבְעָה רוֹעִים — הֶחָכָם וְהָעָם
assignments.reason: This compound describes the goal of approaching the holy shepherds (כלליות של הקדושה). Its essential nature is the shepherds/tzaddikim — the destination. While the means of approach is עזות (Package 3), what you are approaching IS the shepherds (Package 5). The concept is defined by its object: the totality of holiness embodied in the shepherds.

assignments.node_id: להרועים אי אפשר להתקרב כי אם
assignments.package_label: רַגְלִין, מוֹכִיחִים וְשִׁבְעָה רוֹעִים — הֶחָכָם וְהָעָם
assignments.reason: This node fragment ('to the shepherds it is impossible to approach except by...') is essentially a reference to the shepherds and the condition of approaching them. Its essential nature is the shepherd-domain — the concept being approached. It belongs in Package 5 as another expression of the shepherds' centrality.

assignments.package_label: רַגְלִין, מוֹכִיחִים וְשִׁבְעָה רוֹעִים — הֶחָכָם וְהָעָם
assignments.reason: להתקרב ולהתדבק אליהם (to approach and cleave to them) — the 'them' refers to the צדיקי הדור האמתיים (true tzaddikim of the generation). The essential nature is the relationship with the tzaddikim/shepherds. This concept of cleaving to the wise man IS the core dynamic of Package 5 (the tzaddik-people relationship). It produces faith (Package 6) but it IS the shepherding relationship.

assignments.package_label: רַגְלִין, מוֹכִיחִים וְשִׁבְעָה רוֹעִים — הֶחָכָם וְהָעָם
assignments.reason: אפשר להתקרב אל הקדושה (possible to approach holiness) — in context, 'holiness' refers to the holy shepherds who ARE the totality of holiness (כלליות של הקדושה). The teaching says 'על ידי עזות נכנסין לתוך הקדושה' — entering holiness means reaching the shepherds. Its essential nature is the shepherds-as-holiness domain (Package 5).

assignments.package_label: רַגְלִין, מוֹכִיחִים וְשִׁבְעָה רוֹעִים — הֶחָכָם וְהָעָם
assignments.reason: זוכין לקבל מוסר ממוכיחי הדור (meriting to receive rebuke from the generation's rebukers) — the essential nature is the rebukers/מוכיחים domain. The מוכיחים and מוכיחי הדור are already in Package 5 (they ARE the legs/רגלין). Receiving their rebuke is the dynamic of the rebuker-people relationship that defines Package 5. This concept IS about the rebukers' function, not about faith.

assignments.package_label: רַגְלִין, מוֹכִיחִים וְשִׁבְעָה רוֹעִים — הֶחָכָם וְהָעָם
assignments.reason: משמש את החכם (serving the wise man) is the means by which one becomes 'flesh' to the wise man's 'bone'. Its essential nature is the tzaddik-student relationship — the core structural metaphor of Package 5 (חכם האמת = נשמה, עם = בשר). Service IS the active form of the bone-flesh relationship. The חכם is already in Package 5.

assignments.package_label: רַגְלִין, מוֹכִיחִים וְשִׁבְעָה רוֹעִים — הֶחָכָם וְהָעָם
assignments.reason: נעשה בחינת בשר להחכם (becoming flesh to the wise man) — this IS the essential dynamic of Package 5: the people (בשר/flesh) in relation to the wise man (עצם/bone). Both בשר and חכם האמת are already in Package 5. This node describes the formation of that bone-flesh relationship.

assignments.node_id: מש הגוף להנשמה בעשית מצוו‍ת מעשיות
assignments.package_label: רַגְלִין, מוֹכִיחִים וְשִׁבְעָה רוֹעִים — הֶחָכָם וְהָעָם
assignments.reason: The body serving the soul through practical mitzvot is the individual-level parallel of the people serving the wise man. The teaching explicitly draws this parallel: 'וכן על ידי שמשמש הגוף להנשמה בעשית מצוות מעשיות, נעשה הגוף בחינת בשר להנשמה'. This body-soul service dynamic IS the Package 5 relationship (bone/soul ↔ flesh/body) at the personal level. The עם/בשר and נשמה/עצם are all in Package 5.

assignments.package_label: רַגְלִין, מוֹכִיחִים וְשִׁבְעָה רוֹעִים — הֶחָכָם וְהָעָם
assignments.reason: The body becoming flesh to the soul is the personal-level equivalent of the people becoming flesh to the wise man. Same essential nature as the bone-flesh relationship that defines Package 5. Both בשר and נשמה/עצם are already Package 5 concepts.

assignments.node_id: נשבר עזות גופו, ואז מתקרבת ומתדבקת העצם להבשר, הינו הנשמה להגוף
assignments.package_label: רַגְלִין, מוֹכִיחִים וְשִׁבְעָה רוֹעִים — הֶחָכָם וְהָעָם
assignments.reason: This compound describes the result: body's boldness broken, soul (עצם) cleaves to flesh (בשר) = soul to body. The essential nature is the soul-body/bone-flesh reunification — the core structural relationship of Package 5. While the breaking is done by Package 3 (holy boldness), the resulting state — soul cleaving to body — IS the Package 5 relationship restored. עצם, בשר, נשמה, and גוף are all Package 5 concepts.

assignments.node_id: תוכל הנשמה להתקרב עצמה אל הגוף
assignments.package_label: רַגְלִין, מוֹכִיחִים וְשִׁבְעָה רוֹעִים — הֶחָכָם וְהָעָם
assignments.reason: The soul being able to approach the body is the restored bone-flesh relationship. This is the purpose of the entire Torah's argument at the individual level: the נשמה (soul/bone) should be able to reach the גוף (body/flesh). Its essential nature is the soul-body dynamic of Package 5 — the same structural relationship as the wise-man-and-people.

assignments.node_id: נבנה ירושלים, קריה נאמנה, הינו שזוכין לאמונה
assignments.package_label: אֱמוּנָה וִירוּשָׁלַיִם — חוֹתָם הַיָּדַיִם
assignments.reason: נבנה ירושלים, קריה נאמנה, הינו שזוכין לאמונה (Jerusalem is built, the faithful city, meaning one merits faith) — this IS faith/Jerusalem achieved. ירושלים and אמונה are both already in Package 6. This node is the realized/completed form of the faith that defines Package 6. Its essential nature is faith-as-Jerusalem, the telos of the Torah's argument.

assignments.node_id: קר בנין האמונה, שהיא בחינות ירושלים, קריה נאמנה
assignments.package_label: אֱמוּנָה וִירוּשָׁלַיִם — חוֹתָם הַיָּדַיִם
assignments.reason: עיקר בנין האמונה, שהיא בחינות ירושלים, קריה נאמנה (the foundation of faith, which is Jerusalem, the faithful city) — this IS faith-as-Jerusalem. Both אמונה and ירושלים are already in Package 6. This node describes the building/foundation of faith, whose essential nature is the faith domain itself.
